Subject: AWS co-sell: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — Nebula Health opportunity

Hi Jordan / Avery,

Thanks for taking the intro earlier. Nebula Health is moving quickly on a pilot for outpatient summarization (HIPAA scope) and asked us to start the ACE registration + co-sell path so we can get PDM/PSM pairing and the Marketplace listing alignment on the calendar. Quick context: Nebula expects a pilot procurement decision by end of Nov and wants AWS involvement for procurement facilitation and potential joint funding.

Can you confirm the PDM/PSM owners and whether we should submit the ACE intake form or a full listing application as the first step? I've attached a short needs assessment and a draft mutual action plan to accelerate gating items.

Requested next steps:
- AWS: PDM/PSM names and availability for a 30m intro this week
- Nebula (Avery): internal procurement milestone date + list of security artifacts they need for evaluation
- Redwood: we will complete ACE intake and surface listing artifacts (SOC, architecture, unit cost estimates)

Appreciate the quick response — aiming to lock the kickoff before EOW.

Thanks,
Mateo
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Mateo / Avery — thanks for the summary and the attachments.

PDM: Priya Srinivasan (priya.s@amazon.com)
PSM: Daniel Ortiz (daniel.ortiz@amazon.com)

Both are available for a 30-minute intro on Wed 10/13 between 10:00–12:00 PT. Priya asked that we surface the expected ARR/contract size range and any compliance controls (SOC2 type, data residency) ahead of the call.

Recommendation: Submit the ACE intake form (fast path) and include the mutual action plan as an attachment. If you have a public listing artifact package ready, upload that after intake so the Listing team can start cert checks in parallel.

I'll loop in Priya and Daniel now.

Thanks for the intro. Quick alignment items from the PDM side:
- We need a concise one-pager that maps the Nebula pilot use case to AWS procurement incentives (e.g., funding eligibility).
- Security gating: SOC2 Type II report + encryption-at-rest statement + clear data flow diagram. If processing PHI, please confirm whether Nebula will sign a BAA and where PHI is stored.
- Listing ask: a stub listing with estimated SKUs/pricing is fine for now — the Listing org can publish a private listing to allow co-sell activity while final artifacts are prepared.

We can do Wed 10/13 at 10:30 PT for the intro. Please send the one-pager and any security notes before 18:00 PT on Tue so we can brief PSM.

-Priya
PDM, AWS Marketplace

- Expected pilot spend: ~$45k over 3 months, production expansion target Q1 2027
- Procurement ask: potential co-funding or credits to offset pilot proof-of-concept

Action items we will take by EOD Tue:
- Upload ACE intake with attachments (Mateo)
- Drop the one-pager into the HubSpot deal and share link (Karthik)
- Kimberly to prepare listing artifact checklist for the Listing team

Thanks — see you Wed at 10:30 PT.

Mateo
